examples.name: List transactions for a merchant
Filter transactions by card and payor
examples.description: Nested query_list arguments filter transaction rows when the corresponding fields are selected.

examples.name: Invalid column
Charge a card
examples.description: Creates a card transaction by passing card details directly in payment_method.
examples.query:
mutation CreateTransaction(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $payment_method: PaymentMethodInput
  $fee_mode: FeeMode
  $account_code: String
  $reference: String
) {
  createTransaction(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    amount: $amount
    payment_method: $payment_method
    fee_mode: $fee_mode
    account_code: $account_code
    reference: $reference
  ) {
    transaction_id
    merchant_uid
    gross_amount
    net_amount
    currency
    status
    fee_mode
    fees
    transaction_type
    transaction_date
  }
}
